newsitem.title: USA: Marriott in sale-leaseback of 14 hotels.
newsitem.headline: Marriott in sale-leaseback of 14 hotels.

text.p: Marriott International Inc said on Thursday it agreed to sell 10 Residence Inns and four Courtyard hotels to Hospitality Properties Trust for $149 million in cash in a sale-leaseback deal.
Marriott will continue to operate the hotels under long-term, limited-recourse leases. Hospitality will hold security deposits on the leases equal to 10 percent of the total sales price.
The limited-service hotels are in seven states, with a total of 1,819 rooms. Seven of the hotels are currently operating; the other seven are under construction.
Marriott said it plans to add 80,000 rooms by 2001 to its limited-service hotel brands. Most of the growth is expected to come from operating or franchising hotels owned by others.
